'''Cloud City Limited''' is the 11th expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in November 1997. It is 180 cards (90 Light Side and 90 Dark Side): 80 rares, 50 uncommons, and 50 commons. Black border. CardGuide numbering: 11th product (CardGuide lists 181).

It covers the end of ''The Empire Strikes Back''. Debuts include [[Lando Calrissian]] (Light and Dark personas), [[Boba Fett]] (also previewed in [[First Anthology]]), [[Captain Han Solo]], [[Princess Leia]], dueling, and the possibility that Luke is turned to the Dark Side. Like [[Dagobah Limited]], it was sold in 9-card packs (MSRP $2.50), with the last card always the rare.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cloud_City_Limited Cloud City Limited] at Wookieepedia</ref>

== Packaging ==
Limited Edition was sold in 9-card booster packs (MSRP $2.50: 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare) and 60-pack booster boxes. Each box included a fold-out Rules Supplement / card list.<ref name="encyc" />

== Memorabilia ==
Decipher issued a four-panel poster (~32&Prime; &times; 10.5&Prime;) for every expansion from Premiere through Death Star II. Cloud City's reverse is the expansion card list.<ref name="encyc" />

[[File:Cloud-City-Limited-four-panel-poster.png|360px|Cloud City Limited four-panel poster front]]
[[File:Cloud-City-Limited-four-panel-poster-back.png|360px|Cloud City Limited four-panel poster reverse]]

''Front and reverse (Light Side / Dark Side card list)''

The booster box held the fold-out Cloud City Rules Supplement (new rules, including Cloud City locations, cloud sectors, capturing, and crossing over, on one side; card list on the other).<ref name="encyc" />

| style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Cloud-City-Limited-rules-supplement-back.png|360px|Cloud City Limited rules supplement card list]]<br />''Box Rules Supplement (card list)''
|}

== Print sheets ==
Rares are 8&times;10 (80 cards): 40 rares twice per sheet. Uncommons and commons are each 10&times;10 (100 cards): 25 titles four times per sheet.<ref name="encyc" />
